name: Gap-Limited Ray Marching
aliases: Terrain Ray Marching with Gap Limiting
definition: A ray marching algorithm for heightfield terrain that avoids stalling on non-distance fields by using a step size proportional to distance traveled, bounded by half the vertical gap to the surface to prevent overshooting ridgelines.
summary: Gap-Limited Ray Marching is a terrain rendering optimization that prevents overshooting ridgelines by bounding step size with half the vertical gap to the surface.
